svg.title: Six modalities on one clock
svg.desc: Synthetic illustration with invented values, not a recording. Six lanes - speech, language, acoustics, vision, speakers and stories - share one axis in seconds from video start. A marker at 33 seconds reads every lane at the same moment, and the lanes feed one dataset directory of Parquet tables, retained tool output and stage caches, provenance and an optional ELAN export.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Every table is time-stamped in seconds from video start, so one moment can be read across all of them.
